preconditions.description: The number of files n and the number of files to be deleted m must be within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(filename, str) and 1 <= len(filename) <= 100 for filename in filenames)
preconditions.description: All filenames must be non-empty strings with a length between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n for a_i in indices_to_delete)
preconditions.description: The indices of files to be deleted must be valid and within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.description: If a valid pattern exists, the output must indicate 'Yes' and include the pattern.
If no valid pattern exists, the output must indicate 'No'.

postconditions.expression: all(pattern_matches(filename) for filename in files_to_delete) and not any(pattern_matches(filename) for filename in files_not_to_delete)
postconditions.description: The pattern must match all files to be deleted and must not match any files that are not to be deleted.
